name: 80829 · Manitou Spgs, CO
findings: ZIP 80829 (Manitou Spgs) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80829 (Manitou Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80829 (Manitou Spgs) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
